rows.row: S-200F headline and SR-200 gamma-only sensitivity
rows.tag: QUESTIONABLE sourced typical, not a guaranteed minimum
rows.disposition: The inherited arithmetic passes, but the one-optimism sheet conclusion does not survive its own datasheet E. The E290/283 main route still uses two optimisms.
rows.proposed_fix: Keep E, strength and product form together. Reissue the 303-GPa card claims under the ordered grade correction.
rows.already_known: The owner was ordered to correct E at 00:21:45; the observed changed results use E290 and a separate SR-200 modulus. This check does not certify that later packet.

rows.tag: QUESTIONABLE transfer from an orthotropic 1.96-mm sheet lot; not a replacement isotropic specification
rows.disposition: Arithmetic follows the pinned nu=.33. Treat that as an explicit inherited assumption, not a sourced beryllium property. The demonstrated sensitivity changes the preferred two-optimism set.
rows.proposed_fix: A card using a coherent measured in-plane elastic tuple and an appropriate orthotropic model, or an explicitly tagged isotropic approximation.

rows.row: No strength optimism / sheet at guaranteed minimum
rows.effect: No strength optimism is true only relative to the inherited 283-MPa starting value. The current guide's S-200F value does not support that point without an uplift. The 345-MPa sheet number is tensile; equality in compression is an additional transfer assumption.
rows.product_form: The S-200F datasheet offers SR-200 sheet and PS-200 foil as additional options below 6.3 mm; it does not establish an exclusive mandatory substitution. SR-200 below 0.059 inch is available only at smaller sheet dimensions. The datasheet's parenthetic 0.059 inch = 0.5 mm is internally inconsistent (0.059 inch = 1.4986 mm).
rows.disposition: Confirms and sharpens the owner's existing Be-strength/sheet-size NFI; does not stop the estimate.
rows.proposed_fix: Use a matched product/lot/thickness compression value; keep the tensile-to-compressive transfer explicit. MAINLINE-020 is the named grounding card.

rows.location: CR-194164 Table 3; TN D-4833 Table VIII, PDF page 35
rows.effect: 379.2 MPa is supported for the cited sheet directions, but is not the largest compressive value in the source collection. The larger numbers are tube results, not qualified sphere faces.
rows.proposed_fix: Narrow the wording to strongest applicable sheet value among the opened sheet sources. A tube-to-sheet transfer, if pursued, is a separate PROJECTION.
